verdict: Maybe. Wellwith from Noida pitched sea buckthorn-based wellness products on Shark Tank India Season 5, but didn't get a deal. Sea buckthorn from Ladakh and Himachal has a strong origin story.
angle: Sea buckthorn berries grow in Ladakh and are rich in vitamins. Juices, oils and supplements sell to wellness buyers. Sourcing from local communities adds value.
